architecture_rules.strict_isolation: Dual-layer separation between Real Public Zara US Catalogue and Synthetic Operational Data. Operational records must maintain is_synthetic=true and data_origin='synthetic'. Never fabricate or alter catalogue data.
architecture_rules.zero_direct_llm_db_access: The LLM or voice agent must NEVER receive raw SQL access, connection strings, or unrestricted database credentials. All authoritative state interactions must proceed via the Tool Gateway.
two_phase_write_protocol: 3. EXPLAIN STATUS AND CONDITIONS TO USER
architecture_rules.idempotency: Every mutating write requires a unique idempotency_key. Repeat submissions with identical payloads return cached results without re-executing transactions.
architecture_rules.audit_logging: Every tool execution is logged with timestamp, duration, caller request ID, payload, result status, and error codes in tool_audit_log.

rag_requirements.scope: Phase 2D must research and ingest OFFICIAL ZARA US PUBLIC SOURCES (zara.com/us/en). Generic ecommerce templates or invented policies are strictly prohibited.

two_tier_storage.layer_1: Raw Evidence: Unaltered HTTP response, raw HTML, and raw text preserved with cryptographic hashes.
two_tier_storage.layer_2: Clean RAG-Ready Knowledge: Segmented, structured markdown documents with complete provenance metadata.

allowed: Format bulleted lists and numbered procedures
prohibited: Altering policy meaning or legal stipulations
Changing eligibility conditions, fees, or timeframes

rag_requirements.storage_backend: Supabase pgvector extension integrated with unified PostgreSQL database.

belongs_in_rag: Return policy conditions, windows, and fee structures
Shipping options, standard transit times, and delivery policies
Exchange procedures and in-store vs online options
Accepted payment methods and gift card rules
Product care and fabric maintenance guidelines
Size guide explanations and customer service FAQs
belongs_in_tool_gateway: Live product prices, discounts, and active promotions
Real-time variant and SKU inventory levels
Physical retail store locations and stock availability
Specific customer accounts, orders, line items, and tracking numbers
Return authorization and return item processing
Active refund transaction status and monetary calculations

rag_requirements.business_rule_discrepancy_audit: Before altering deterministic backend rule constants (e.g. 30-day return window), generate a formal discrepancy audit comparing CURRENT_BACKEND_RULE against OFFICIAL_POLICY_RULE.

security_rules.credentials_protection: Never commit .env, API keys, database URLs, or service role keys to Git. Keep .env gitignored.
security_rules.secret_logging: Do NOT print, log, or transmit secrets or credentials in standard output, audit records, or trace logs.
security_rules.service_role_isolation: Service role key is restricted strictly to trusted backend processes; never expose to client or frontend.
security_rules.gateway_authentication: All Tool Gateway endpoints enforce X-Tool-Secret validation.
security_rules.rls_enforcement: Catalogue tables permit public read via RLS; operational tables deny anonymous access and require authenticated backend execution.
